## Multiband parameter estimation

This was already somehow handled for PE with stellar mass binaries with LISA, e.g. [this paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2007.08544.pdf) or [this one](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2003.00357.pdf) (Mersat, Baker, Dal Canton).
The merger time is not a good parameter to do PE, it degenerates with the chirp mass a lot.
One can instead do PE with a time at some fixed frequency, which can be optimized.

Inspiration for a way to do multibanding, perhaps?

Independent group tackling the same problem: [Buscicchio+](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.05259.pdf) in Birmingham.
